description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT. This role offers the flexibility of both full-time and part-time schedules, providing an excellent opportunity to deliver high-quality patient care in a home setting while enjoying a competitive salary.

As a Home Health RN, you will play a crucial role in assessing, planning, and implementing care for patients in their homes, promoting independence and improving their quality of life. This position allows you to build meaningful relationships with patients and their families, making a direct impact on their well-being.

If you are an experienced RN looking for a rewarding role with a strong compensation package, we encourage you to apply. This is an urgent need, and we are actively interviewing qualified candidates.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent home health experience
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Excellent clinical assessment and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, based on experience and contract type.
